errors.evidence: The description omits half of the chart's purpose. The title is "Trend of daily new patient numbers AND news media report numbers" (每日新增患者人数与新闻媒体报道数目变化趋势), but the description only mentions new cases, completely ignoring the data on news reports.

errors.text_span: 来自不同国家的新增确诊新冠病例数
errors.evidence: The description claims the bars represent new cases from different countries. However, the legend specifies the bars represent "该日全球确诊数量" (Global confirmed cases on that day).

The date range is incorrect. The chart's x-axis begins on July 1, 2022 (2022年7月1日) and ends around August 26, 2022. The description states an incorrect start date (July 15) and end date/month (September 26).

errors.text_span: 标签为“每日全体人数与新增病例数目”
errors.evidence: The label for the left vertical axis is misidentified. The actual label is "每日新增患者人数" (Daily new patient numbers).
The description completely omits the second, right-side vertical axis, which represents "新闻媒体每日报道数目" (Daily news media report numbers) and has a scale from 0 to 6000.
The tick interval for the left vertical axis is incorrect. The labeled ticks are at intervals of 200,000 (e.g., 200000, 400000, 600000), not 100,000.
The description fails to mention the existence of the line chart, which represents the number of COVID-19 news reports. The chart is a combination bar and line chart, not just a bar chart.

errors.text_span: 图中的柱状图代表不同的国家
errors.evidence: This repeats the error from the first sentence. The bars represent global daily totals, not data for different countries.

errors.text_span: 颜色依次为浅绿色、浅蓝色、浅黄色和深蓝色
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates multiple colors for the bars. In reality, all bars are a single color (teal/turquoise).

errors.text_span: 最长柱状图，对应于2022年8月22日
errors.evidence: The longest bar is incorrectly identified. The bar for August 22 is one of the shortest on the chart. The longest bar occurs around mid-July (approx. July 19th).

errors.text_span: 最短柱状图，对应于2022年8月5日
errors.evidence: The shortest bar is incorrectly identified. The bar for August 5 is of medium height (approx. 600,000), whereas the shortest bars (e.g., on Aug 22) are much lower, around 200,000.
